summary: Implemented compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator in botocore/args.py, added the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-enum to botocore/regions.py, made the STS global-endpoint predicate accept a None endpoint config, and added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (26 tests) to tests/unit/test_args.py. tests/unit/test_args.py (59 tests) and tests/unit/test_client.py pass together (312 tests). Nothing is committed. Black and flake8 are not in the shared venv, so line lengths and import order were checked by hand. Choices to review: SDK::Endpoint is kept as a key with value None when absent; the helper calls the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint methods.
